crossRefs.note: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us…
In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my…
Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of…
Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God…
who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still…
But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the…
And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory…
Yahweh do so to Jonathan, and more also, should it please my father to do you evil, if I don’t disclose it to you, and…
For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may Yahweh reward you good for that which you…
Then Saul said to David, “You are blessed, my son David. You will both do mightily, and will surely prevail.” So David…
Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people, and for the cities of our God; and may Yahweh do what seems good to…
Now, my son, may Yahweh be with you and prosper you, and build the house of Yahweh your God, as he has spoken…
of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may Yahweh be with you.”

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: David said, “Yahweh who delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine.” Saul said to David, “Go! Yahweh will be with you.”
translations.bsb: David added, “The LORD, who delivered me from the claws of the lion and the bear, will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine.” “Go,” said Saul, “and may the LORD be with you.”
translations.kjv: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.
translations.asv: And David said, Jehovah that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and Jehovah shall be with thee.
